title: Rewrite homepage (page 1) to make governance vs orchestration obvious
story: As a technical decision-maker landing on the site, I want to immediately understand what DaemonCore is (and isn't), why orchestration isn't enough, and what concrete mechanisms DaemonCore introduces, so I can decide whether to read deeper.
description: Rework the homepage hero, add an evolution/plateau section, define governance vs orchestration, list concrete mechanisms with brief implementation examples, and include an honest V1 vs V1.5 callout.
acceptance_criteria: Homepage headline/subhead clearly state: orchestration ≠ governance.
Includes an evolution strip (raw prompts → better prompts → prompt engineering → orchestration → DaemonCore).
Includes a short 'where risk appears' breakpoint section (drift, ambiguity, responsibility).
Includes 3 mechanism bullets with examples: Action protocol, MAX bus, template-driven ops (IP-safe wording).
Includes a concise V1 vs V1.5 callout using versioned language (no implying V1.5 exists today).
All copy avoids absolutes and performance promises; UK spelling.
